name: Pset_RobotReadiness

properties.name: RoIM_Level
properties.description: R0 | R1 | R2 | R3 | R4. RoIM Level of Information met by this element for its task scope.

properties.name: RoIM_TaskScope
properties.description: Robotic tasks this element is ready for, e.g. Navigate, Scan, SetOut, Drill, Finish, Inspect (semicolon-separated).

properties.name: Traversable
properties.description: True if a ground robot may cross or occupy the element.

properties.name: KeepOutZone
properties.description: True if no robot may enter the element or its space.

properties.name: ControlPointRef
properties.description: ID of the survey control point the element is set out from.

properties.name: PositionTolerance
properties.description: Design placement tolerance (+/-), in project length units (mm recommended).

properties.name: RegistrationTarget
properties.description: True if the element is usable as a scan-to-model registration feature.

properties.name: SettingOutPoints
properties.description: Reference to a setting-out point set (CSV file name or IfcGrid/IfcAnnotation ID).

properties.name: SurfaceType
properties.description: Finished surface the robot touches, e.g. Concrete fair-faced, Gypsum board, Glazing.

properties.name: SubstrateMaterial
properties.description: Material behind the surface, for drilling and fixing.

properties.name: ScheduleTaskRef
properties.description: 4D programme task ID the element belongs to.

properties.name: AsBuiltState
properties.description: Not started | In progress | Installed | Verified | Non-conforming.

properties.name: MeasuredDeviation
properties.description: Worst measured deviation from design at last verification (mm recommended).

properties.name: LastVerifiedDate
properties.description: ISO 8601 date of last verification, e.g. 2026-11-10.

properties.name: VerificationSource
properties.description: Robot or scan ID plus a link to the evidence.
